definition_of_done: Every workflow actor resolves to one persona id.
Each persona has responsibilities, decisions, permissions, pain points, and success measures.
Personas describe real operational roles rather than generic users.

After the owned section passes, append or update agent_evidence for persona_research_agent with status done, at least one scoped check in checks_passed, and an empty checks_failed list. Unfinished downstream stages are dependencies, not failures of this task.
